verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a first-party, per-project MCP server that gives AI coding assistants like Cursor, Claude Code and VS Code Copilot a live connection to the API spec and docs, with MCP call analytics. The docs excerpts do not show connection setup, authentication, or which tools are exposed, so how deep the capability goes is unproven. missing for 10: documented connection/auth setup steps, enumerated MCP tools/capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Your MCP server gives AI coding assistants — Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code Copilot — a live connection to your API spec and documentation.
Every time an AI client calls a tool on your project's MCP server, ReadMe records the call.
